dialogues.speaker: Gummer
dialogues.text: Interested in the Forge? I'm quite the expert.

dialogues.speaker: Gummer
dialogues.text: I used to work here, but my body eventually couldn't keep up with the work inside. With a little luck, I was able to join the Millelith afterwards.

dialogues.speaker: Gummer
dialogues.text: In broad strokes, Blackcliff Forge is staffed by miners who smelt ores as they dig tunnels.

dialogues.speaker: Gummer
dialogues.text: Of course, we also reinforced the tunnels and built factories with safety considerations in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Gummer
dialogues.text: The bounty that Rex Lapis has bestowed upon Liyue all resides in this mine, and building factories within the mountain itself is the most efficient method of extracting that bounty.
